ITEM 1 | Finely shredded orange strands, bright orange with slight sheen, thin matchstick-like threads about 0.2 cm wide and 5-8 cm long, piled in a loose mound in upper-left of plate, covering roughly 15% of plate area, moist and springy-looking | 60
ITEM 2 | Whole small round red tomato, glossy smooth skin, about 4 cm diameter, sitting at top center of plate near the shredded strands | 45
ITEM 3 | Sliced green cucumber, pale-to-medium green with white flesh edges, half-moon and wedge slices about 0.5 cm thick and 4-5 cm long, scattered in the left-center and center of plate, moist surface | 55
ITEM 4 | Green bell pepper pieces, bright green, cut into thin strips and chunks about 0.5 cm thick and 2-4 cm long, slightly glossy and firm, clustered center-left next to cucumber and carrot | 40
ITEM 5 | Halved or whole cherry-type red tomatoes, glossy red skin, about 3-4 cm across, three pieces at right-center and bottom-center of plate, smooth and juicy-looking | 80
ITEM 6 | Diced cooked chicken-like pieces, pale off-white to light tan with light browning at edges, cubes about 1-1.5 cm, somewhat firm, lying in a small cluster right-center of plate beside carrot shreds | 35
ITEM 7 | Small scattered carrot shreds and bits, orange, thin strands about 3-4 cm long, dispersed among the chicken and cucumber near center of plate, slightly moist | 8
ITEM 8 | Small pale green celery-like pieces, light green with pale stalk ends, about 1-2 cm long pieces scattered near bottom-left of cluster, crisp-looking | 6
